Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.

<CLT=cltMIND>This doesn't look like a normal school pool...
more like a pool at a resort.

<CLT=cltMIND>The pool is deep, but it isn't filled
up all the way. Still, plenty of water to swim in.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is a storage room.
There's a bunch of pool equipment inside...

<CLT=cltMIND>This building is the gym.
That's the same window I saw in there.
<CLT=cltMIND>This building...is the school building.

<CLT=cltMIND>Most of the windows are blocked off,
but one looks like it's usable.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a large diving board.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is also something you would
find at a resort...

<CLT=cltMIND>Some pool rules are posted here.
There's one that I find peculiar...

Swimming is prohibited during nighttime.
Well, I don't really want to swim anyway.

<CLT=cltMIND>There are also some specifications
written here...

<CLT=cltMIND>The pool is 82 feet in length
and is 39 feet wide...

<CLT=cltMIND>The poolside is 13 feet on each end,
and the left and right sides are 8 feet each...

<CLT=cltMIND>Huh. Guess that's just
useless information...
